objective: Test empirical association of CRR target-score sensitivity with actual full-gallery target-rank changes, explicitly accounting for competition.
dataset: All released CIR-QDiag data: 931 groups, 3420 originals, 10131 edits. The 930 groups with edits enter edit-response statistics.
gallery: 109598 available PinPoint images, same set for every original/edited query and model; reference images retained. Two unavailable images match prior retrieval manifest; no required positive/reference is missing.

models.clip_original: CLIP-L/14, zero residual composer initialization; original embedding behavior.
models.clip_oprd: Released CLIP-L RIM + OPRD checkpoint checkpoints/clip_l_s2.
models.qwen3_vl_2b: Original Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B (not instruction-tuned or a trained student checkpoint).
models.bge_s2: BGE-VL-MLLM-S2, same teacher family/checkpoint used for released CLIP OPRD training; not S1.

inference.clip: Native CLIP normalization and RIM composer; gallery/reference image embeddings reused. Mean reference vectors normalized before composition. FP16 model.
inference.qwen: Native model code with SDPA, BF16, max_length 8192, min_pixels 4096, max_pixels 262144. Native last non-padding token pooling. Candidate instruction: Represent the image for retrieval. Query instruction: Represent the composed image retrieval query.
inference.bge: Native S2 and released compatibility patch, FP16, SDPA, 512x512 RGB input, original CIR task instruction, original candidate template, left padding, last-token pooling. use_cache=False.
inference.multireference: For Qwen/BGE each reference is paired with the full text and encoded natively; mean per-reference vectors then FP32 L2 normalization.
inference.storage: All final vectors normalized and stored in FP32; cosine dot products FP32 with TF32 disabled.
inference.backend_benchmark: SDPA/FlashAttention batch comparisons archived; production retained SDPA consistently. No partial caches mix attention backends.

rank_definition: 1 + count(score_j > score_t) + count(score_j == score_t and gallery_ID_j < gallery_ID_t). Stable full-gallery ranking; all positive target ranks retained, no Top-K censoring.

statistics.calibration: Model-specific group-balanced weighted empirical 95th percentile of absolute target-score changes across pairs of positive paraphrases. Full dataset and pilot500 calibrated separately.
statistics.crr: Per target/edit event score_delta > calibration threshold; then average targets, edits within source instruction, source instructions within group, groups equally.
statistics.weighting: Same hierarchy used in conditional rates and weighted Spearman. Operation subsets renormalize this hierarchy inside each subset.
statistics.primary_subset: ADD/SUBSTITUTE (5735 edits) for directionally expected target demotion. DELETE (4396 edits), ADD/SUB individually and all edits separately reported.
statistics.margin: s(query,target) minus the tenth highest-scoring other gallery image. The competing boundary is recomputed for original and edited queries.
statistics.bootstrap: 2000 resamples of whole groups; seed42. Threshold held fixed. Weighted Spearman uses group-resampled weights and recalculates weighted ranks in each replicate.
statistics.additional: Conditional demotion given CRR/non-CRR, conditional Top-10 exit, rank effects beyond paraphrase controls, group-level CRR versus demotion-rate Spearman, explicit score/rank exceptions.

scope_caveats: Score-drop/rank-change Spearman is not correlation between four model-level CRR values.
CRR triggering need not imply rank demotion; empirical exceptions are retained.
DELETE removes a condition and can leave the original target valid; downward movement is descriptive, not necessarily desirable.
Historical main-table CRR was based on pilot500; do not substitute full-dataset CRR into that table.
All dataset positive target IDs are included, matching original evaluation; the generation-stage visual review inspected a bounded subset of positives.
Floating point/backend precision can yield small differences relative to earlier evaluation runs.
verification: Synthetic tests plus 34 sampled original/edited queries per model checked by direct competitor counts; independent NumPy ordering checks Top-50 and partition checks target-excluded margins.
